title: Niagara Falls Day Trip from Toronto with Boat & Journey Option
includes: Journey Behind the Falls (If Option Selected)
Round trip transportation to and from Niagara Falls, Canada
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience a convenient and stress-free journey from Toronto to Niagara Falls with this round-trip shuttle service. Departing from 120 Bremner Blvd, Toronto, this service offers a comfortable and efficient way to visit one of Canada’s most iconic destinations.

 Upon arrival in Niagara Falls, guests can enjoy up to 6 hours of free time to explore at their own pace or choose to upgrade to a guided Niagara Falls tour. After your visit, return transportation back to Toronto ensures a seamless end to your day.

 This option is ideal for travellers seeking flexibility while avoiding the hassle of planning transportation.
